title: bassemu~
description: `bassemu~` emulates a transistor bass synthesizer and outputs an audio signal, with controls for oscillator waveform, tuning, filter, envelope, glide, and output limiting. Send note events as lists beginning with a note number, using `-1` for note-off; the remaining resonance, envelope modulation, decay, and pulse-width parameters are optional. An external audio source can also be fed into its leftmost inlet.
